summary: Iteration 15 testing completed. Login/Logout UX improvements verified: Account button in header shows VIP badge + 'Demo' text, clicking opens dropdown with wallet info (Connected Wallet address, chain type, Balance), 'Connect Real Wallet' button (demo mode only), and 'Exit Demo & Switch Wallet' button. Disconnect properly clears localStorage (aifund_wallet, aifund_demo_mode) and returns to landing page. Click-away listener closes dropdown. All features working on both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js: Account dropdown uses data-testid attributes correctly (account-menu-btn, account-dropdown, disconnect-btn, switch-to-real-btn)
Dashboard.js: Click-away listener properly implemented using useEffect with document.addEventListener
App.js: disconnectWallet function correctly clears both localStorage keys (aifund_wallet, aifund_demo_mode) and resets all state
Dashboard.js: Conditional rendering for demo mode shows 'Exit Demo & Switch Wallet' vs 'Disconnect & Switch Wallet' for real wallet
Dashboard.js: Chain type detection works based on wallet address prefix (0x=EVM, T=Tron, else=Solana/Demo)
test_credentials: Demo mode via 'Free Demo' button - no credentials needed
